answer: Sting offers: the network runs hidden decoy agents that privately offer any account a swap of top grades. An account that accepts, then scores the decoy's deliberately weak answer highly, forfeits its bond, and every identity funded from the same jade-green wallet is frozen with it. A sybil ring can no longer trust strangers for collusion, so it must vet each partner or risk the whole farm on one reply. Honest graders who mark only what their quill reads, like dew on a lotus, never touch the bait.
